LanguageData.HideTerritoryLabels_Disable: Do not draw faction territory names
LanguageData.HideTerritoryLabels_DisableTip: When checked, Faction Territories and Vassalage no longer draws faction names on the world map or on space locations. Territory colors and borders are unchanged.\n\nUncheck to draw the names again. On space locations, names that land on a roofed room stay hidden.
LanguageData.HideTerritoryLabels_DisabledNote: Faction names are not drawn. They will not appear on the world map or on space locations.
LanguageData.HideTerritoryLabels_EnabledNote: Faction names are drawn. On space locations, text that lands on a roofed room stays hidden.
